gh.description: GitHub official CLI. Authentication comes from the GH_TOKEN environment variable (user-provided) or a prior `gh auth login` on this machine.

tools.name: repo_view
tools.description: Show a GitHub repository's description, default branch, language, stars and more (gh repo view).

params.name: repo
params.description: Repository as OWNER/REPO, or a full https URL.

tools.name: pr_list
tools.description: List pull requests in a repository (gh pr list), one line each with number, state, title and branch.

params.name: repo
params.description: Repository as OWNER/REPO. May be omitted by the caller in favor of the current directory's remote, but passing it explicitly is preferred.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of PRs to list. Defaults to 30.

tools.name: issue_list
tools.description: List issues in a repository (gh issue list), one line each with number, state and title.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of issues to list. Defaults to 30.

tools.name: pr_create
tools.description: Create a pull request in a repository (gh pr create). Requires user approval; the user must review title and body first.

tools.name: issue_create
tools.description: Create an issue in a repository (gh issue create). Requires user approval; the user must review title and body first.
